instruction: Fix `tail` so n=0 returns an empty list (the slice `[-0:]` currently returns the entire file).
gold_patch:
diff --git a/fileops.py b/fileops.py
--- a/fileops.py
+++ b/fileops.py
@@ -20,6 +20,8 @@
     """Return the last ``n`` lines of a text file."""
     with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
         lines = f.read().splitlines()
+    if n <= 0:
+        return []
     return lines[-n:]
